module.name: Monochrome
module.author: Viscousity
module.description: True Lossless FLAC & authentic 320k multi-source provider with dual Tidal endpoints, Amazon Music/Qobuz ISRC precision resolution, 4-tier quality selector, and predictive 0ms pre-warming.

qualityOptions.label: Lossless CD · 16-bit / 44.1 kHz FLAC
qualityOptions.description: Bit-perfect authentic CD quality FLAC stream from Monochrome (25–50 MB).

qualityOptions.label: Studio Master · 24-bit / 96–192 kHz FLAC
qualityOptions.description: Ultra high-resolution studio master FLAC stream (50–120 MB).

qualityOptions.label: High Speed · 320 kbps AAC
qualityOptions.description: Progressive high-bitrate stream via JioSaavn CDN with instant start (8–12 MB).

qualityOptions.label: Data Saver · 160 kbps AAC
qualityOptions.description: Lightweight progressive stream for mobile data saving (4–6 MB).

fallbackMode.label: Failover Strategy
fallbackMode.description: Stream failover behavior if requested quality is unavailable

options.label: Seamless Failover (FLAC -> 320k AAC)
options.description: Never interrupt playback; drop to authentic 320k if FLAC is unavailable

options.label: Strict Lossless Only
options.description: Strictly stream FLAC; do not fall back to lossy audio

skipSensitivity.label: Skip Velocity Sensitivity
skipSensitivity.description: Debounce interval to cancel intermediate requests when rapidly skipping tracks

options.label: Ultra Fast (30ms debounce)
options.description: Shortest delay, ideal for rapid skips on high-speed connections

options.label: Balanced (60ms debounce)
options.description: Optimal balance between responsiveness and network protection

options.label: Relaxed (100ms debounce)
options.description: Prevents burst traffic on slower mobile networks

autoPrewarmNext.label: Predictive Next-Track Pre-warming
autoPrewarmNext.description: Pre-warm stream URL for upcoming queue items to achieve 0ms gapless start
